message.content:
The outline will trace a young market clerk moving through the ancient street and watching ordinary trades become proof of collective prosperity. The short story will end when the clerk accepts a commission that ties all the stalls into one shared livelihood.
* Opening: the clerk enters the street and is overwhelmed by bright textiles, clay pots, and fragrant spice piles
* Middle: the clerk witnesses a barter over smoked tobacco and a copper brooch while a metalworker hammers beside a tobacconist
* End: the clerk realizes that each exchange feeds the city’s communal energy and leaves him eager to return
